question: How is the daily washing of the mouth symbolically interpreted in this teaching?
premises: Washing of the mouth is done always.
It is described as going upward.
inference: The daily washing of the mouth is symbolically understood as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The exact symbolic meaning of ūrddha-gatam is open to interpretation.
plain_english: O beloved, the daily washing of the mouth is understood as going upward to Brahman.
